name: venn-manager-frontend
description: Preact frontend for Venn Manager. Behaviour contract: CONTRACTS/FRONTEND.md.

comments.vite: Pinned to 6.x. Vite 7 and 8 require Node ^20.19 || >=22.12, and the project's toolchain runs Node 20.17. Bump vite, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8 and jsdom together once Node is upgraded.
comments.typescript: Pinned to 5.9. TypeScript 7 is the native-port rewrite; nothing in this stack needs it and the plugin ecosystem is still catching up.
comments.jsdom: Pinned to 26.x, the last release supporting Node 18+. Only used as the vitest DOM environment.
comments.wouter-preact: Chosen over preact-router: smaller, hook-based, and actively maintained. Both are approved by AGENTS.md.
comments.no-eslint: AGENTS.md approves no frontend linter. `tsc --noEmit` under strict mode is the static gate.
